`145-145`: **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **Assert that the detail response supplies the DKIM record.** Line 151 checks only `success`. If `dkims/dkim-id` returns an empty or discarded `dnsTxtRecordValue`, the method can still report success while omitting the DKIM record. Assert that `result['dns_records']` contains `dkim-value`.
Suggested test assertion ```diff $this->assertTrue($result['success']); + $this->assertContains('dkim-value', array_column($result['dns_records'], 'value')); ```
